scoring_justification: Recompute of DFT energies is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; we compare agent's reported scalar values to paper-reported values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold formation energies of Pd_Mo+O_S defect-pair
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: 'the relevant energy for ... Pd_Mo+O_S would drop down to -3.68 eV' (applies to both 1T and 2H polytypes as per Fig. 1)

hidden_assets.purpose: gold deltaG_H for S1 site in 1T-MoS2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: ΔG_H on pure MoS2 is 2.11 eV, and 'the calculated ΔG_H at the S1 sites ... dropped dramatically by 1.98 eV', yielding 0.13 eV
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: computed from paper's own stated values

hidden_assets.purpose: gold deltaG_H for O site in 1T-MoS2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: 'the doped O atoms also behaved as new active sites with the value of ΔG_H = -0.24 eV'

hidden_assets.purpose: gold deltaG_H for S1 and O sites in 2H-MoS2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: estimated from Fig. 5 of the paper, approximate values 0.37 and -0.21 eV, consistent with statement that 1T outperforms 2H
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: derived from the paper's own graphical data; reference solution uses these values

formation_energy_Pd_Mo_plus_O_S_1T.description: Formation energy (eV) for Pd_Mo+O_S defect-pair in 1T-MoS2

formation_energy_Pd_Mo_plus_O_S_2H.description: Formation energy (eV) for Pd_Mo+O_S defect-pair in 2H-MoS2

deltaG_H_S1_1T.description: ΔG_H (eV) for H adsorption at S1 site in 1T-MoS2

deltaG_H_O_1T.description: ΔG_H (eV) for H adsorption at O site in 1T-MoS2

deltaG_H_S1_2H.description: ΔG_H (eV) for H adsorption at S1 site in 2H-MoS2

deltaG_H_O_2H.description: ΔG_H (eV) for H adsorption at O site in 2H-MoS2

outputs.description: DFT-calculated formation energies of the Pd_Mo+O_S defect-pair in 1T- and 2H-MoS2, and Gibbs free energies of hydrogen adsorption at the most active S and O sites near the defect.

output_contract.notes: All energies are in eV. The output file must contain exactly these six fields with numeric values. The hidden checker compares the reported values to paper reference values with appropriate tolerances.
